content_sections.heading: HNBGU Group B Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized by a Screening Committee, which prepares a list of eligible/not-eligible candidates based on its own guidelines/criteria. No interview will be held for Group 'B' and Group 'C' posts carrying Grade Pay of ₹4,600 or less, as per MHRD letter No. 19-50/2015-Desk-U dated 22.12.2015 — this applies to all 12 posts in this notification. The University reserves the right to conduct a written test/skill test for any post, as per its Cadre Recruitment Rules, if it deems fit. Where prescribed (Private Secretary, Personal Assistant), a computer-based skill test in stenography and typing will be conducted as per the norms listed under Eligibility. Selection Committee decides its own method for evaluating candidate performance, wherever applicable. A reserve panel/waiting list may be drawn up, valid for one year from the selection committee's decision, and may be used for consequential/new vacancies.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HNBGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the SAMARTH recruitment portal: hnbgunt.samarth.edu.in (link live from 17 August 2026). Register and fill the prescribed online application form with complete and correct information. Upload high-resolution, clearly readable, digitally verifiable scanned copies of degree/certificates, mark sheets, and experience certificates. Pay the applicable application fee online via credit/debit card, Net Banking, or UPI. Applicants already in government/other service must upload a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer along with the application. Applicants from non-government organizations must submit Form-16 to support claimed experience for salary/emoluments. Review and submit the application before 16 September 2026, 6:00 PM . Only online applications will be accepted — hard copies must not be sent to the University. Important: Applications not supported with the required readable, self-attested enclosures will be outright rejected, with no further communication entertained on the matter.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (as prescribed for the post applied for) Experience certificates supporting the claimed years of relevant experience Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD), where claiming reservation — OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, if already in service Form-16, if applying with experience from a non-government organization CR dossier (last 5 years, duly certified) with employer's forwarding, if applying on deputation basis Reprints of important publications, where applicable to the post Self-attested English/Hindi translation of any certificate not originally in English or Hindi

faq.question: Q1. How many Group B Non-Teaching posts has HNBGU announced for 2026?
faq.answer: HNBGU has announced 27 Group 'B' Non-Teaching posts across 12 post types under Notification No. HNBGU/RECT/NT/2026/55.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 16 September 2026 by 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 for UR/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates and ₹500 for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and women applicants; fees are non-refundable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an interview for these posts?
faq.answer: No. Per MHRD guidelines, no interview is held for Group B/C posts with Grade Pay ₹4,600 or less; the University may instead conduct a written or skill test.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HNBGU Group B posts?
faq.answer: Age limit is 35 years for most posts and 40 years for Assistant Engineer (Civil), Horticulturist, and Assistant Information & Public Relation Officer.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I apply for HNBGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at hnbgunt.samarth.edu.in; hard copies are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for the Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree plus 3 years as UDC (or 8 years as LDC) in a government/PSU/University/autonomous body, with computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q8. Can reserved-category candidates apply for unreserved posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but they will not get any age or marks relaxation when applying against an Unreserved (UR) post.

faq.question: Q9. Is age relaxation available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, as per applicable DoPT/Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate online application and separate fee payment is required for each post.
